workLog.action: Verified invoke_hook_drift_guard.py is genuinely redundant before deleting. Removed the hook source and its test, and dropped its entry from the pretooluse-2-retrospective_gate group in dispatch_groups.json (7 shims to 6).

Repointed the .claude/hooks/ regen row at the build-all-check pre-push job in lefthook.yml; deleted the 'Hook shim drift at push time' gate row (subsumed by the 'Full pipeline staleness' row above it, which already cites build_all.py --check plus the named pre-push job); and removed the retired guard's source-pointer row.
